query:
SELECT mt.tableName, COUNT(mf.id) as fieldCount 
FROM metadata_tables mt 
LEFT JOIN metadata_fields mf ON mt.id = mf.tableId 
GROUP BY mt.tableName 
ORDER BY mt.tableName 
LIMIT 20;
